description:
Purpose: Record what the user did with postings a monitor found, or put postings back; one call decides up to 100 postings at once, and the reply separates the ones decided from the ones that failed. Deciding a posting already decided the same way changes nothing, and a posting the monitor does not hold is listed back and left alone.
When: After the user says what they did with a posting, or wants a decided posting back.
Cost: About 20 tokens per posting.

decision.description: What the user did: applied to the postings, skipped them, or open to put them back among the postings not applied to or skipped yet.

monitorId.description: The monitor the postings belong to, from monitor_list or monitor_get.

postingIds.description: Ids of the monitor's postings to decide, 1 to 100, from monitor_get.

name: monitor_decide

outputSchema.description: The postings' states after the decision.

failed.description: Ids whose state could not be written just now; present only when some.

monitorId.description: The monitor the postings belong to.

notFound.description: Ids the monitor does not hold; nothing changed for them; present only when some.

postings.description: Each decided posting with its state; a posting already in that state is listed unchanged.

items.description: One posting with the state it is in now.

state.description: The posting's state after the call.

title: Record decisions on monitor postings
